nodes.description: Public owner address of the Ownable contract; holds the privileged account that passes the onlyOwner check.
Ownable() constructor that initializes the owner state variable from the caller address.
onlyOwner modifier that requires the caller to equal the stored owner before executing the guarded function body.
Ownable.transferOwnership(address) that sets the owner to a new address after the onlyOwner check and non-zero address check.
msg.sender read inside the Ownable constructor and assigned to the owner state variable.
msg.sender read inside the onlyOwner modifier and compared against the owner state variable.
newOwner address parameter of Ownable.transferOwnership, written into the owner state variable.
require(msg.sender == owner) access-control guard inside the onlyOwner modifier.
Public pendingOwner address in Claimable holding the candidate owner awaiting acceptance.
onlyPendingOwner modifier that requires the caller to equal the pendingOwner before executing the guarded function body.
msg.sender read inside the onlyPendingOwner modifier and compared against the pendingOwner state variable.
require(msg.sender == pendingOwner) access-control guard inside the onlyPendingOwner modifier.
Claimable.transferOwnership(address) that stores the proposed new owner in pendingOwner instead of transferring ownership directly.
newOwner address parameter of Claimable.transferOwnership, written into the pendingOwner state variable.
Claimable.claimOwnership() that lets the pending owner finalize the transfer by moving pendingOwner into owner and clearing pendingOwner.
Public boolean in GlobalPause signaling whether all referenced tokens are paused.
Public string in GlobalPause holding the human-readable notice used as the revert reason when paused.
GlobalPause.pauseAllTokens(bool,string) restricted to onlyOwner that updates allTokensPaused and pauseNotice.
_status boolean parameter of pauseAllTokens, written into the allTokensPaused state variable.
_notice string parameter of pauseAllTokens, written into the pauseNotice state variable.
GlobalPause.requireNotPaused() view function that reverts with pauseNotice when allTokensPaused is true.
require(!allTokensPaused, pauseNotice) guard inside requireNotPaused that blocks execution while tokens are paused.

edges.reason: The untrusted msg.sender in the Ownable constructor is written directly into the owner state variable, establishing the initial privileged account.
The Ownable constructor performs the state write of owner from the caller address.
The caller msg.sender flows into the require(msg.sender == owner) access-control comparison.
The onlyOwner modifier executes the owner equality require before running the guarded function body.
The onlyOwner modifier guards Ownable.transferOwnership, gating execution on the owner check.
The newOwner parameter is consumed by Ownable.transferOwnership after the zero-address check.
Ownable.transferOwnership writes the new owner address into the owner state variable.
The newOwner parameter value ultimately reaches the owner state variable assignment.
The caller msg.sender flows into the require(msg.sender == pendingOwner) access-control comparison.
The onlyPendingOwner modifier executes the pending owner equality require before the guarded body.
The onlyPendingOwner modifier guards claimOwnership, gating the ownership finalization on the pending owner check.
The newOwner parameter is consumed by Claimable.transferOwnership to record the proposed owner.
Claimable.transferOwnership writes the proposed address into the pendingOwner state variable.
The newOwner parameter value reaches the pendingOwner state variable assignment.
claimOwnership assigns the pendingOwner value to the owner state variable, finalizing the transfer.
claimOwnership resets the pendingOwner state variable to address(0) after the transfer.
The pendingOwner value is copied into owner during claimOwnership, completing the two-step ownership transfer.
The inherited onlyOwner modifier continues to guard the overridden Claimable.transferOwnership entry point.
The inherited onlyOwner modifier guards GlobalPause.pauseAllTokens, restricting pause control to the owner.
The _status boolean parameter is consumed by pauseAllTokens.
The _notice string parameter is consumed by pauseAllTokens.
pauseAllTokens writes the provided status into the allTokensPaused state variable.
pauseAllTokens writes the provided notice into the pauseNotice state variable.
The _status parameter value reaches the allTokensPaused state variable assignment.
The _notice parameter value reaches the pauseNotice state variable assignment.
requireNotPaused executes the pause guard requirement before returning.
The allTokensPaused state variable is read by the require(!allTokensPaused, pauseNotice) guard.
The pauseNotice state variable is used as the revert message of the pause guard.

normalization_plan.reason: The newOwner parameter only exists to be written into owner by Ownable.transferOwnership and has no independent behavior, so it is merged into the function node.
The newOwner parameter only exists to be stored into pendingOwner by Claimable.transferOwnership, so it is merged into the function node.
The _status parameter is a pure input carrier assigned to allTokensPaused and is therefore merged into pauseAllTokens.
The _notice parameter is a pure input carrier assigned to pauseNotice and is therefore merged into pauseAllTokens.
